column2: shape
loops (one or several) on a long vertical stem, phi-like
a mark shaped like the digits 43 written together
a mark shaped like a cursive a
closed down-pointing triangle whose top side is a horizontal bar, nothing above the bar, no second bar
closed down-pointing triangle with a top bar AND a second horizontal bar crossing its bottom point
a mark shaped like the digit 6
a 4-shaped element (4 with a crossbar) sitting above a small triangle or V
an infinity sign or figure-8 lying on a horizontal bar
two loops on a stem, one above the other (o-T-o)
a loop on a stem with a bar at the foot
an E-like bracket open to the right whose top bar is joined to the foot of the vertical by a fine hairline diagonal, the foot bar longer than the top bar and tapering into a tail (H22 group A)
a plain squared C or gamma open to the right: top bar and foot bar on a vertical, no diagonal, the top bar longest, often a short spur of the vertical above the top bar (H22 group B)
a closed capital I: a thin vertical with a bar on both sides at top and foot (H22 group C)
a 7 or Z hook over two close slanted stems, crossed
a plain plus or cross, possibly with a stroke rising to the upper right
a dark e-shaped loop with a curling tail
a 4-shaped element above two stems on a bar (4 over pi)
a dense crossed-4 cluster, hash-like, with stems
a single loop on a long stem (not phi-like, not double)
a mark shaped like a cursive h
a beta-like shape: a loop at the top of a stem with a 3-like bowl below it
a mark shaped like ll
a 4 with a long crossed stem and no triangle below
any cipher sign matching none of the above (describe it in the note)
two loops side by side at the head of a stem, nothing above them (H26: the b/o glyph; the trefoil and the stacked pair are e/r)
